! WARNING: the server entry tacacs server OLD-TACACS is at the address of the standard server, and IOS
! refuses a second entry with the same address and key: the region removes it (and the group entries
! that name it) before it adds the standard block, and the back-out puts it back.
! WARNING: the block switches command authorization on ('aaa authorization commands',
! 'config-commands') with its last lines: from then on every command is authorized by the server, so
! paste it as a user the server knows (or with local first), and keep the second terminal for the
! back-out.
! The change is live when the paste ends. NOTHING rolls it back by itself. Keep a second terminal
! logged in at privilege 15 until the end.
! Paste over ssh, not the console; on a console paste at most twenty lines at a time and watch the
! echo for '% Invalid'. Pasting the region twice is harmless.

! Type this first, on dev-cisco-same-address-block-nocmd, and check the name:   show version | include uptime
! The prompt must end in # (privileged mode), not in (config)#, before you paste: a prompt ending in >
! means type enable first, a prompt with (config) in it means a configuration session is open: type
! end first.

!!!!! PASTE FROM HERE: dev-cisco-same-address-block-nocmd !!!!!
configure terminal
! aaa: the method lists tacctl renders, each replaced by the rendered line
aaa group server tacacs+ TACACS-GROUP
 no server name OLD-TACACS
no tacacs server OLD-TACACS
tacacs server TACACS
 address ipv4 192.0.2.10
 key lab-secret-0123456789abcdef
 single-connection
 timeout 5
aaa group server tacacs+ TACACS-GROUP
 server name TACACS
aaa authentication login CONSOLE local
aaa accounting commands 15 default start-stop group TACACS-GROUP
! aaa: the login method of the console and vty lines
line con 0
 login authentication CONSOLE
! aaa: command authorization, last on purpose
aaa authorization commands 1 default local group TACACS-GROUP
aaa authorization commands 7 default local group TACACS-GROUP
aaa authorization commands 15 default local group TACACS-GROUP
aaa authorization config-commands
end
